findings.notes: Fresh changed endpoint captures across all profiles show full-width prose registers. Synchronous write acknowledgment and worker acknowledgment remain whole words, including narrow light/dark.
Fresh motion samples show small activity dots in place of generic wrapping Update text. Source bytes, chamber headings, and committed residents remain visible.

manual_inspection.endpoint_method: Inspected all 193 changed PNGs in native-pixel contact sheets; controls/context checked in full frames as needed. Reused 123 exact decoded-pixel matches only after checking each same lesson/case/state/profile old PNG byte hash in the historical all-endpoint inspection report.
manual_inspection.motion_method: Fresh native Next, Pause, and Finish selections: one nontrivial base-case action per lesson in all four profiles, 32 paused in-flight PNGs. Personally inspected each scene at native text resolution and full-frame contacts for context. Recorded prior committed index, actual animation time, paused moving state, and exact finished endpoint. No claim of continuous video or all-transition coverage.

limits: No actual student participants, comprehension study, or measured learning gain.
All declared endpoint states/cases/profiles; motion sampled at selected nontrivial transitions, not every instant.
This report does not itself apply catalog acceptance or authorize publication.
